title: Star Ratings Drift: code and derived data
description: Code and derived data for the paper "Star Ratings Drift: Temporal Concept Drift in Large-Scale Review Sentiment Classification". The study uses the Electronics category of Amazon Reviews 2023. No review text is included: every review is identified by a key (user ID, parent ASIN and normalized-text hash) that can be rebuilt from the official data. Code is released under the MIT License; derived data, results and figures under CC BY 4.0.
